--- title: "職業安全衛生儀表板" format: html: theme: flatly toc: true code-fold: true embed-resources: true editor: source --- ## 績效指標摘要 {.tabset} ### 關鍵指標卡片 ::: {.cell .column-screen-inset} ```{.r .cell-code} # 計算安全天數（從最後一次事故到今天） # 確保日期格式正確再進行計算 if(nrow(incidents) > 0) { last_incident <- max(incidents$incident_date, na.rm = TRUE) total_safe_days <- as.numeric(difftime(today, last_incident, units = "days")) total_safe_days <- max(0, total_safe_days) # 確保不為負數 } else { total_safe_days <- 0 } # 計算今年失能傷害次數 current_year <- year(today) disabling_incidents <- incidents %>% filter(incident_type == "失能傷害", year(incident_date) == current_year) %>% nrow() # 假設每月總工時 200,000 小時 monthly_hours <- 200000 if(disabling_incidents > 0) { current_fr <- round(disabling_incidents * 1000000 / (monthly_hours * month(today)), 1) } else { current_fr <- 0 } # 未結案缺失數 open_defects <- inspections %>% filter(is_closed == FALSE) %>% nrow() # 有效許可證數 active_permits <- permits %>% filter(status == "approved", end_datetime > today) %>% nrow() # 使用卡片顯示 layout_columns( value_box( title = "累計安全天數", value = total_safe_days, showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("calendar-check"), theme = "primary" ), value_box( title = "失能傷害頻率 (FR)", value = paste0(current_fr, " (次/百萬工時)"), showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("graph-up"), theme = "secondary" ), value_box( title = "未結案缺失", value = open_defects, showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("exclamation-triangle"), theme = "danger" ), value_box( title = "有效許可證", value = active_permits, showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("file-check"), theme = "success" ), col_widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}

累計安全天數

20

失能傷害頻率 (FR)

1.7 (次/百萬工時)

未結案缺失

2

有效許可證

0

 ``` ::: ::: ### 事故趨勢圖 ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} if(nrow(incidents) > 0) { # 先建立月份欄位 incidents_with_month <- incidents %>% mutate( month = floor_date(incident_date, "month") ) %>% count(month, incident_type, .drop = FALSE) %>% complete(month = seq(min(month), max(month), by = "month"), incident_type = unique(incident_type), fill = list(n = 0)) ggplot(incidents_with_month, aes(x = month, y = n, color = incident_type)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) + geom_point(size = 3) + labs(title = "事故/事件趨勢", x = "月份", y = "次數") + theme_minimal() + scale_color_manual(values = c("失能傷害" = "red", "輕傷" = "orange", "虛驚事件" = "blue")) } else { ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "無事故資料") + theme_void() } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](dashboard_files/figure-html/incident-trend-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### 缺失類型排行 ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} if(nrow(inspections) > 0) { defect_summary <- inspections %>% filter(!is.na(defect_type)) %>% count(defect_type, sort = TRUE) %>% head(6) ggplot(defect_summary, aes(x = reorder(defect_type, n), y = n, fill = defect_type)) + geom_col() + coord_flip() + labs(title = "缺失類型排行", x = "", y = "次數") + theme_minimal() + guides(fill = "none") } else { ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "無缺失資料") + theme_void() } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](dashboard_files/figure-html/defect-ranking-1.png){width=768} ::: ::: ## 承攬商工作許可證管理 {.tabset} ### 許可證總覽表 ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # 確保日期格式正確 permits_table <- permits %>% mutate( end_date = as_date(end_datetime), days_left = as.numeric(difftime(end_date, today, units = "days")), status_display = case_when( status == "expired" ~ "⚠️ 已過期", days_left < 0 ~ "⚠️ 已過期", days_left <= 3 ~ "🔴 即將到期", days_left <= 7 ~ "🟡 即將到期", status == "pending" ~ "⏳ 審核中", status == "approved" & days_left > 0 ~ "✅ 有效", TRUE ~ status ) ) %>% select(許可證編號 = permit_number, 承攬商 = contractor_name, 作業類型 = work_type, 風險 = risk_level, 地點 = location, 結束日期 = end_date, 剩餘天數 = days_left, 狀態 = status_display) datatable(permits_table, options = list( pageLength = 10, dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel') ), rownames = FALSE) %>% formatStyle("風險", backgroundColor = styleEqual( c("高", "中", "低"), c("#ffcccc", "#ffffcc", "#ccffcc") )) %>% formatStyle("剩餘天數", color = styleInterval(c(0, 3), c("red", "orange", "black")), backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(0), c("#ffeeee", "white"))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 即將到期許可證提醒 ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} expiring <- permits_table %>% filter(剩餘天數 >= 0, 剩餘天數 <= 7) %>% arrange(剩餘天數) if(nrow(expiring) > 0) { cat("### ⚠️ 下列許可證將在 7 天內到期\n\n") print(knitr::kable(expiring, format = "html", caption = "即將到期許可證清單")) } else { cat("✅ 目前無即將到期之許可證\n") } ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ✅ 目前無即將到期之許可證 ``` ::: ::: ### 承攬商清單 ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} contractors_display <- contractors %>% mutate(合作狀態 = ifelse(is_active, "🟢 合作中", "🔴 暫停")) %>% select(承攬商名稱 = contractor_name, 統一編號 = uniform_number, 聯絡人 = contact_person, 電話 = phone, 狀態 = 合作狀態) datatable(contractors_display, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 5, dom = 't')) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 申請審核 ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pending_permits <- permits %>% filter(status == "pending") %>% mutate(申請日期 = as_date(start_datetime)) %>% select(申請編號 = permit_number, 承攬商 = contractor_name, 作業類型 = work_type, 風險 = risk_level, 申請日期) if(nrow(pending_permits) > 0) { cat("### 📋 待審核申請\n\n") print(knitr::kable(pending_permits, format = "html")) cat("\n\n> 💡 提示：點擊下方按鈕可進行審核（需串接後端 API）\n") } else { cat("✅ 目前無待審核申請\n") } ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ### 📋 待審核申請
申請編號 承攬商 作業類型 風險 申請日期
P-2026003 丙公司 侷限空間 高 NA
> 💡 提示：點擊下方按鈕可進行審核（需串接後端 API） ``` ::: ::: ## 附錄：原始資料 ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ### 事故紀錄 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
